---5 Customers w/ Deposits
SELECT TOP 5 A.ORGKEY FROM BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS A LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP B ON A.CORE_CUST_ID = B.CUST_ID 
    ---WHERE B.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ('M', 'J') AND (A.ORGKEY LIKE ('R%') OR A.ORGKEY LIKE ('P%'))
    WHERE B.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ('M', 'J') AND (A.ORGKEY LIKE ('C%') OR A.ORGKEY LIKE ('B%'))
---5 Customers w/ Loans
SELECT TOP 5 A.ORGKEY FROM BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS A LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN B ON A.CORE_CUST_ID = B.CUST_ID 
    ---WHERE B.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ('M', 'J') AND (A.ORGKEY LIKE ('R%') OR A.ORGKEY LIKE ('P%'))
    WHERE B.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ('M', 'J') AND (A.ORGKEY LIKE ('C%') OR A.ORGKEY LIKE ('B%'))
---5 Customers w/ Credit Cards
SELECT TOP 5 CUST_NBR FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER
---5 Customers w/ Trust
SELECT TOP 5 UNIQUE_ID FROM BUSC.TRU_CUST WHERE UNIQUE_ID LIKE ('R%') OR UNIQUE_ID LIKE ('P%')
SELECT TOP 5 UNIQUE_ID FROM BUSC.TRU_CUST WHERE UNIQUE_ID LIKE ('C%') OR UNIQUE_ID LIKE ('B%')
---5 Customers w/ Treasury
SELECT TOP 50 CustomerId FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'TRY' 
    ---AND CustomerId LIKE ('R%') OR CustomerId LIKE ('P%')
    AND CustomerId LIKE ('C%') OR CustomerId LIKE ('B%')
---5 Customers w/ Securities
SELECT TOP 5 CLTCODE FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT WHERE CLTTYPE = 'I'

SELECT TOP 5 CustomerID FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' AND CustomerID IN

    (SELECT CustomerID FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'TRU' AND CustomerID IN
    (SELECT  CustomerID FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'TRY')))

SELECT A.TRANDATE, A.AVE_CURR_BALANCE, C.ORGKEY, D.FORACID
    FROM BUSC.DEP_TBLMONTHLYADB A
        INNER JOIN BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP B ON B.ACID = A.ACID
        INNER JOIN BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS C ON C.CORE_CUST_ID = B.CUST_ID
        LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER D ON A.ACID = D.ACID
    WHERE 
        B.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ('M', 'J') AND
        B.isLatest = 1 AND
        B.isActive = 1 AND 
        C.ORGKEY = 'R00579203'
    GROUP BY A.TRANDATE, A.AVE_CURR_BALANCE, C.ORGKEY, D.FORACID

    FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES A
        INNER JOIN BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP B ON B.ACID = A.ACID
        INNER JOIN BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS C ON C.CORE_CUST_ID = B.CUST_ID
        LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER D ON D.ACID = A.ACID
    WHERE 
        B.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ('M', 'J') AND
        B.isLatest = 1 AND
        B.isActive = 1 AND
        C.ORGKEY = 'R02236026'
    GROUP BY D.FORACID, A.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE, C.ORGKEY

SELECT A.EOD_DATE, A.TRAN_DATE_BAL AS TOT_REL_EXPOSURE, C.ORGKEY, D.FORACID
    FROM BUSC.LNS_EODACCTBAL A
        INNER JOIN BUSC.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN B ON B.ACID = A.ACID
        INNER JOIN BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS C ON C.CORE_CUST_ID = B.CUST_ID
        LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST D ON D.ACID = A. ACID
    WHERE 
        B.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ('M', 'J') AND
        B.isLatest = 1 AND
        B.isActive = 1 AND
        C.ORGKEY = 'R01288565'
    GROUP BY A.EOD_DATE, A.TRAN_DATE_BAL, C.ORGKEY, D.FORACID ORDER BY A.EOD_DATE DESC
SELECT E.CoreCustomerId, A.CustomerAccountId, SUM(A.BalanceAmount) AS TotalRelationshipExposure
SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT  a.CustomerAccountId, a.PeriodStartDate, a.BalanceAmount
            FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance a
                WHERE a.PeriodStartDate = (SELECT MAX(b.PeriodStartDate) FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance b
                WHERE a.CustomerAccountId = b.CustomerAccountId AND
                a.PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' AND
                a.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS')) as A
            INNER JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation C ON C.CustomerAccountId = A.CustomerAccountId
            INNER JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory D ON D.CustomerAccountId = C.CustomerAccountId AND D.SerialNumber = C.SerialNumber
            INNER JOIN BNKM.Customer E ON C.CoreCustomerId = E.CoreCustomerId
            WHERE 
            D.RecordTypeId IN ('M', 'J')
            ---AND BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.PeriodStartDate = '20230112'
            GROUP BY E.CoreCustomerId, A.CustomerAccountId
SELECT SourceSystemCode, COUNT(*) FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance A GROUP BY SourceSystemCode
    WHERE A.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' A.PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' AND 
    LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation B
    LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory C
    LEFT JOIN BNKM.Customer D
    WHERE C.RecordTypeId IN ('M', 'J')

---R01466839 (Antonio), R00525907 (. Baguio)

SELECT * FROM DW.FactTotalRelationshipBalance WHERE CustomerID = 'R00525907' --- Check TRB
SELECT * FROM DW.FactTotalRelationshipExposure WHERE CustomerID = 'R01466839' --- Check TRE
SELECT * FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount WHERE CustomerID = 'R01466839' --- Check Accounts
SELECT ---TOP 10 --- Check Branch and Deposits Outstanding Balance
    A.CustomerID, A.AccountID, 
    B.BusinessDateSK, B.BalanceAmountProrated, A.SourceSystemCode, C.BranchID, D.AccountStatus
    FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount A
    LEFT JOIN DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance B ON A.AccountSK = B.AccountSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch C ON A.BranchSK = C.BranchSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount D ON A.AccountSK = D.AccountSK
    WHERE A.CustomerID = 'R01466839'
    ORDER BY A.CustomerID, B.AccountID, B.BusinessDateSK 
SELECT ---TOP 10 --- Check Branch and Deposits Outstanding Balance
    A.CustomerID, A.AccountID, SUM(B.BalanceAmountProrated) AS DepOutBal, A.SourceSystemCode, C.BranchID, D.AccountStatus
    FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount A
    LEFT JOIN DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance B ON A.AccountSK = B.AccountSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch C ON A.BranchSK = C.BranchSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount D ON A.AccountSK = D.AccountSK
    WHERE A.CustomerID = 'R01466839'
    GROUP BY A.CustomerID, A.AccountID, A.SourceSystemCode, C.BranchID, D.AccountStatus
